cohort_rankings: Not published. No matched competitor after-captures exist in this source set, so there is no Ky gap, no provider-wide rank and no proven competitive win. The original 40-image competitor ratings (initial/reranked) scored different pictures and are not comparable to these.

drift.status: Not a re-score. implemented-post-messages scored kypost-03-after images, which are different pixels; this round scores kypost-05-after. Differences below are context for product change, not rubric drift, and were read only after the freeze.
drift.spread: No second reviewer scored these 05 files; no per-file spread exists.

kypost.admin-console: N/A: Server, Users, Quarantine and Security admin surfaces not captured
kypost.loading / error states: N/A: not captured for any task view
kypost.named themes: N/A: only Busnes Light and Busnes Dark captured
kypost.hover state: N/A: static captures; recorded separately in kypost-06-followup-hover.json

keyboard.evidence: Recorded (kypost-05-after-checks.json, Busnes Light/Dark, source-05-after): phone Tab walk of 16 strip stops; reader opened with Enter, Tab reaches Reply first, Escape closes and returns focus to the row; contact editor first focus Close, Escape returns to New Contact; earlier stages recorded desktop nav order and compose Escape focus return. Not recorded: complete task paths (send, save contact, bulk actions, appearance choice) and phone order: the implementer records that Tab visits the strip before Logout, which sits above it, and that there is no skip link. Not executed by this reviewer.

focus.evidence: Recorded solid 2px rings on all 16 phone strip stops and on the first reader action stops (both themes); earlier: desktop nav and toolbar. Not recorded for form fields, contacts row actions, appearance swatches, compose controls or any named theme.

contrast.evidence: Recorded: Quill stroke/picker vs toolbar 16.06 (light) / 12.67 (dark), Quill border 3.63 / 4.77; earlier selected pairs (nav, labels, field border, danger) in Busnes plus 3 named presets. Not every element or every shipped named theme. Visual note, not a contrast failure: danger text (#b42318 light, #ff8176 dark) sits close in hue to the accent (#bf3f18 / #f5865f).

states.evidence: The gate requires captured empty, loading and error states per task view, with errors announced and tied to fields. None are captured in stage 05 (same as the prior round). This is a missing-evidence failure of the gate requirement, not a finding that the product lacks those states.

responsive.evidence: Recorded overflowX 0 at 1280x900 and 390x844 on every capture (manifest), and on /read, /contacts and /settings/appearance at 1024x768, 768x1024 and 360x740; phone header 105px with a 1-row scrolling strip and the current item in view; contact-editor footer on screen. Not recorded: target size; the images show native ~13px row checkboxes on phones. Visible: compose Quill toolbar wraps one button to a second line at 390px.

kypost.reason: Quality below 9.0 in every cohort, ky_fit below 9.0, and no gate passes.

checks_recorded.kypost: Recorded by the implementer, not executed by this reviewer: npm test 1189/1189 (full runs on source-05-final x2, source-06-followup, source-07-test-wait), typecheck clean, lint 0 errors / 0 warnings, build pass, ky-ui vendor check 0.3.0, npm audit 0 (runtime, dev, lint/), check-toolchains and check-env-example pass. App first-test flake under parallel host load: in-batch wait means 1076 ms current vs 1090 ms baseline, but batch failures 7/23 current vs 0/9 baseline; a beforeAll warm-up failed and was reverted; source-07 adds a scoped 5 s findBy wait in two tests (the parent owns test timing). Regression neither proven nor ruled out. NOT run: Go vet, golangci-lint, govulncheck, go test -race, container build, shellcheck, compose checks, worker typechecks (left to the real PR CI). Not covered: screen readers, named-theme captures, loading/error captures.

recorded_evidence_notes: kypost-05-after-checks.json reader-keyboard entries record "heading": null in both themes. The image shows the subject as the dialog title and the implementer cites a ReadPage unit test for the accessible name, but the browser check itself does not confirm it.

remaining_defects.defect: ~60px checkbox gutter on a 390px row; sender lines wrap mid-address; six unlabelled icon-only selection actions; native ~13px checkboxes

plain-text body in monospace (stranded 'so the' line on phones); fixed tall bordered body box holding two lines; full-width Keywords input between facts and body (box-in-box); 13px labels beside ~16px values; icon-only phone tools
TO:/CC:/BCC: capitals beside 'Subject:'; five stacked bands; Quill stepper picker; phone toolbar orphan (clear-format) and two-row actions
Actions heading misaligned with Edit/Delete; chevron floats mid-column; Delete without danger colour; oversized New Contact label; phone primary last after wrapped secondaries
native file control shown beside 'Save the contact first to add a photo'; no required/optional marking
expanded Settings pushes the account region to the viewport floor and the licence line below the fold

danger hue close to accent (#b42318 vs #bf3f18; #ff8176 vs #f5865f); dark dialogs separate from the backdrop mainly by the 1px border; envelope mark vs suite 'B' stamp, white content vs cream page, 'Logout' vs 'Sign out'

gap_to_9.quality: every cohort below 9.0; needed +1.15 (contact-editor 7.85) to +1.75 (mail-read 7.25); 156 of 168 dimension scores are 7 or 8, none 9, twelve 6s (phone density, selection affordances, reader typography)
gap_to_9.ky_fit: 8.08; needs ~+0.92; suite_cohesion 7 and type_geometry 7-8 hold it back
gap_to_9.gates: states fails on missing captures; keyboard, focus, contrast and responsive untested
gap_to_9.assessment: Clearing the listed defects plausibly lifts affected dimensions to 8; 9 ('nothing to remove') needs further refinement no current image shows. No outcome is predicted and no new polish round is started by this review.

unscored_reasons: None: all 28 inventory files are unique and scored. Other council images (kypost-05-before, earlier stages, other products) are outside this source set; two other-product captures were viewed for suite_cohesion only.
